fact: A new public-security police station at Bégoua, built and equipped by MINUSCA, was received by the Director General of the national police on 25 February 2026; MINUSCA says it has so far supported 38 security infrastructure and equipment projects in the country, and that its support also includes modernising the criminal databases.
title: Inauguration du nouveau commissariat de sécurité publique à Bégoua
